dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - PostgreSQL - Health
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for PostgreSQL availability, connections, transactions, cache behavior, deadlocks, checkpoints, and storage. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Database health
pages.description: PostgreSQL integration overview grouped by availability, load, capacity, and storage.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(db.uptimeInMilliseconds) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(db.connections), latest(db.maxconnections) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(db.commitsPerSecond), sum(db.rollbacksPerSecond) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(db.bufferHitsPerSecond), sum(db.readsPerSecond) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(db.deadlocksPerSecond), sum(db.conflicts.locksPerSecond) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT sum(bgwriter.checkpointsScheduledPerSecond), sum(bgwriter.checkpointsRequestedPerSecond), sum(bgwriter.checkpointWriteTimeInMillisecondsPerSecond) FROM PostgresqlInstanceSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(table.totalSizeInBytes), latest(table.indexSizeInBytes) FROM PostgresqlTableSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name, schema_name, table_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Read availability and connections first, then transaction load, cache behavior, checkpoint pressure, and table-level storage growth.
